notes: Verifier K, wave 4. Printed: 'When this creature enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Garruk, Savage Herald, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.' Expectation from the text: the search is optional; declining leaves Garruk in the library and the hand empty.
